source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Available1945062 discussion retracts the initial UIDPLUS/server-only explanation after remote Dovecot reproduction: per-message source-delete URLs accumulated after the local copy looked complete. The author explicitly keeps per-message deletion for moves into IMAP, where append and deletion alternate. The assigned local Start/WriteStart path removes that redundant deletion while EndMove retains bulk deletion after copy success. This is a scoped implementation correction, not a general reversal of deleting a source only after its destination succeeds. Existing records 928bd34b7510220c9caa9971159228d5b81c017e58a0971fd404c24c666a40aa and d05f824e39bb7c984090dbb1ca4ed2349f83c3229f1f8e908f9166eed66bd8a2 own mechanism and failure-path limits. Review asks spell out local folders and remove debugging output; Not Done thanks-for-documenting row is praise. Main bug comments 0–18 and review were read; related bug 1828372 missing19 and bug 399475 gap remain. The current source confirms only selected local path and bulk-success/failure branches, not remote queue timing or all other IMAP moves. No source-preservation experiment or passing Try inferred. Zero full audit credit.
title: The IMAP-to-local queue correction is scoped to the destination path
